checks.finding: REQ-001 through REQ-008 each have at least one observable acceptance criterion: AC-001 (manifests), AC-002/003 (deterministic handoff), AC-004/005/006/015 (boundary), AC-007/008/014/016 (SessionStart), AC-009 (PostCompact), AC-010/013 (no-op safety), AC-011 (write/security scan), and AC-012 (documentation).
Every stated goal REQ-001..REQ-008 is explicitly mapped by the acceptance table's Requirement column, with no orphan goal and no orphan acceptance criterion.

Acceptance criteria specify externally checkable outcomes: schema/linter validation, byte-identical files, exact boundary values, stdout content, exit codes, JSONL append count, and security-scan findings.

Non-goals explicitly exclude LLM summarization, SDD state-machine changes, blocking compaction, private conversation payload integration, and retroactive reconstruction, which bounds the otherwise expandable compaction-safety feature.
Material constraints are stated: Node 18+ with absence handling, writes limited to .sdd/context/ and reports/context/, no network/secrets/LLM, hook inputs documented, and .sdd/context/ git-ignored.
The Risks section names compaction blocking, non-determinism, and over-permissive writes; each has a corresponding validation surface via AC-010, AC-002, and AC-011 respectively.
Project root has no domain/ directory, so the domain-conformance check does not apply for this feature.
